masonry_indicators: Hair-line cracks in very few walls; fall of small pieces of plaster
rc_indicators: Fine cracks in plaster over frame members or in structural walls at base; fine hairline cracks in partitions

masonry_indicators: Cracks in many walls; fall of fairly large pieces of plaster; partial collapse of chimneys
rc_indicators: Cracks in columns and beams; cracks in structural shear walls; cracks in partition/infill walls; fall of brittle cladding
source_location: EMS-98 p.15-16; IS 13935 Table 1 p.5; Table 9 p.29

masonry_indicators: Large and extensive cracks in most walls; roof tiles detach; chimneys fracture at roof line; failure of individual non-structural elements
rc_indicators: Cracks in columns and beam-column joints at base; spalling of concrete cover; buckling of reinforcing rods; large cracks in partitions; out-of-plane failure of infill panels
source_location: EMS-98 p.15-16; IS 13935 Table 1 p.5; Table 9 p.29

masonry_indicators: Serious wall failure with gaps; inner walls collapse; partial structural failure of roofs and floors
rc_indicators: Large cracks with compression crushing; fracture of reinforcing bars; bond failure; tilting of columns; collapse of few columns or single upper floor pancake
source_location: EMS-98 p.15-16; IS 13935 Table 1 p.5; Table 9 p.29

masonry_indicators: Total or near-total collapse; disintegration of bearing walls; floors pancake to ground
rc_indicators: Ground floor soft-storey pancake collapse or total collapse of entire wings/building
source_location: EMS-98 p.15-16; IS 13935 Table 1 p.5; Table 9 p.29
